lane: G30-S19 (self-assigned and frozen in lane-g30s19-preregistration.md; prompt's method paragraph was not identifiable — IR-S19-01)
hypothesis: H-A: unmapped faults are persistent linear discontinuities coincident across magnetic, gravity and topographic fields; a habitat model using only the 19 competition bands and label-free edge/coherence transforms (no catalogue-distance inputs) recovers hidden whole fault components better per false-positive unit than proximity or belief-ordered thinning.
mechanism: HistGradientBoosting habitat belief from 40 features (19 robust-normalized bands + gradient magnitudes, |Laplacian|, multi-scale local std, structure-tensor coherence/energy on RTP, cross-physics edge-coincidence products); negatives sampled >3 px from all catalogue traces (halo treated as unlabelled); prevalence-corrected probabilities; EDGE expected-marginal-DTI greedy emission (shared emitter_opt); support restricted to footprint pixels >2 px from the catalogue (mechanism learned from H33 forensics, dots independently generated).
non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts and dike edges produce coincident magnetic/gravity gradients without fault offset; saline facies mimic conductivity structure.

holdout.label: HOLDOUT-DTI
holdout.protocol: whole 8-connected catalogue components withheld (split_components seed=31, spatially interleaved); 300 m (3 px) training buffer around hidden pixels; catalogue features from visible faults only; visible faults masked pixel-exactly; pooled DTI alpha=0.2 beta=0.8 R=300 m triangular
holdout.ci_method: component bootstrap, 500 draws, seed 7, conditional on observed FP weight (FP held fixed)
